summary_en: 900,000 shares (2.8% of 31.81M shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥1.8B upper limit, open-market purchase on TSE, Aug 12 – Dec 17, 2026. Rationale: enhanced shareholder returns and improved capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of resolution on acquisition of treasury shares (acquisition of treasury shares pursuant to the Articles of Incorporation under Article 165, paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On 10 August 2026, Milbon's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 900,000 treasury shares (2.8% of the 31.81 million shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for an aggregate ceiling of ¥1.8 billion. The acquisition will be executed through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period 12 August 2026 to 17 December 2026. The company stated that the buyback is intended to enhance shareholder returns and further improve capital efficiency, after a comprehensive review of business environment and financial position. The resolution is authorized under Article 165, paragraph 3 of the Companies Act as applied to Article 156.
